title: Army money continues after the Round Table closes

tellings.quote: But, it all the while he was getting money from the Army. I mean, there's records of that.

plain: A group in Maine known as the Round Table shut down in 1957, but the man behind it kept getting money from the Army the whole time, according to the researcher Greg Malatzi. He tells Michels "there's records of that", pointing to Army funding records without quoting them. If true, it would mean the Army was paying for this work, and kept paying after it officially ended.
